activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of concepts, theories and principles in Physics
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of the concepts, theories and principles in Physics
activities.learning_activity: (a) Explain the fundamental principles of measurement (dimensional analysis, precision, accuracy and uncertainties)
suggested_methods: Think-ink-pair-share: Give opportunity to students to perform individual tasks on the fundamental principles of measurements and allow them to share with others
Hands-on activities: Provide students with the opportunity to engage in real-world activities re lated to the fundamental principles of measur ements
activities.assessment_criteria: Fundamental principles of measurements are clearly explained

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of concepts, theories and principles in Physics
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of the concepts, theories and principles in Physics
activities.learning_activity: (b) Describe the basic tenets of mechanics and two dimensional motion (projectile motion, circular motion, rotation, gravitation and fluid mechanics)
suggested_methods: Interactive digital simulation: Guide students through interactive demonstrations, explanations, hands-on activities and questions to describe the basic tenets of mechanics and two dimensional motion
activities.assessment_criteria: Concepts and principles related to mechanics are correctly described

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of concepts, theories and principles in Physics
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of the concepts, theories and principles in Physics
activities.learning_activity: (c) Describe the fundamental concepts, principles and theories underlying the thermal properties of materials (heat transfer, kinetic theory of solids, liquids and gases, thermodynamics and thermal radiation)
suggested_methods: Scenario: Guide students to discuss some scenarios related to transfer of heat or radiation in different materials
Virtual simulation: Allow students to explore and manipulate thermal properties of materials virtually
Practical work: Guide students to carry out experiments on thermal properties of materials related to their real-life experiences
activities.assessment_criteria: Concepts, principles and theories underlying the thermal propertiesof materials are correctly described
suggested_resources: calorimeter and thermocouple thermometers, calorimeter and thermocouple

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of concepts, theories and principles in Physics
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of the concepts, theories and principles in Physics
activities.learning_activity: (d) Explore the basic tenets of vibrations and waves (simple harmonic motion, and wave propagation {interference, diffraction and polarization})
suggested_methods: Group discussion: Facilitate group discussions for students to share their observations and ask questions about basic tenets of vibrations and waves

Interactive simulation and virtual labs: With the aid of videos, animations, and online sources, provide opportunity for students to conduct virtual and hands-on experiments related to vibrations and waves
Problem-based learning: Provide students with scenarios or case studies that require them to apply the theories and principles of vibrations and waves they have learnt to solve practical problems
activities.assessment_criteria: Concepts, theories and principles related to vibrations and waves are correctly described

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of concepts, theories and principles in Physics
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of the concepts, theories and principles in Physics
activities.learning_activity: (e) Explain the concept, theories and principles of electrostatics (electric field, electric potential and capacitance)
suggested_methods: Think-ink-pair-share: Guide students to perform individual tasks on the concepts, theories and principles of electrostatics then ask them to share with others
Practical work: Guide students in groups to perform hands-on activities of electrostatics related to their real-life experiences
Field trip: Organise a field trip to help students visit places where electrostatic sprays, painting and photocopying activities are done
activities.assessment_criteria: Concept, theories and principles of electrostatics are correctly explained

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of concepts, theories and principles in Physics
activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Use various instruments to carry out measurements in Physics
activities.learning_activity: (a) Use various instruments to carry out experiments in mechanics, vibrations and waves, thermal properties of materials and electrostatics
suggested_methods: Hands-on activities: Guide students to use various instruments to conduct experiments related to mechanics, vibrations and waves, thermal properties of materials and electrostatics
Project work: Guide students by using scenarios or case studies, to work on a certain project and come up with a scientific solution
activities.assessment_criteria: Various measuring instruments are applied accordingly in mechanics, vibrations and waves, thermal properties of materials and electrostatics
suggested_resources: retort stand and steel balls of varying diameters

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of concepts, theories and principles in Physics
activities.specific_competence: 1.2 Use various instruments to carry out measurements in Physics

suggested_methods: Group discussion: Facilitate group discussions for students to share their experiences and ask them some questions on the precision and accuracy of measurements
activities.assessment_criteria: Precision and accuracy of measurements is correctly processed

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of concepts, theories and principles in Physics
activities.specific_competence: 1.3 Analyse the efficacy of different techniques and instruments in physical measurements
activities.learning_activity: (a) Analyse the strengths and weaknesses of various instruments and techniques used in mechanics, vibrations and waves, thermal properties of materials and electrostatics
suggested_methods: Problem-based learning: Guide students to analyse the strengths and weaknesses of instruments and techniques used in mechanics, vibrations and waves, thermal properties of materials and electrostatics
activities.assessment_criteria: Strengths and weaknesses of various techniques and instruments used in physical measurements are correctly analysed

activities.main_competence: 2.0 Conduct experiments in Physics
activities.specific_competence: 2.1 Carry out experiments in Physics
activities.learning_activity: (a) Design and carry out scientific experiments related to mechanics, vibrations and waves, thermal properties of materials and electrostatics
suggested_methods: Hands-on experiments: Guide students to observe phenomena and perform experiments related to mechanics, vibrations and waves, thermal properties of materials and electrostatics and allow them to discuss on their real-world applications
activities.assessment_criteria: Experiments are designed and carried out according to underlying procedures

activities.main_competence: 2.0 Conduct experiments in Physics
activities.specific_competence: 2.1 Carry out experiments in Physics
activities.learning_activity: (b) Use ICT tools to analyse and present data (Ms Excel, PSPP , R, MATLAB, Python and Origin)
suggested_methods: Hands-on activities: Guide students through interactive demonstrations and explanations to manipulate data using ICT tools
activities.assessment_criteria: Data are analysed and presented using ICT tools

activities.main_competence: 2.0 Conduct experiments in Physics
activities.specific_competence: 2.1 Carry out experiments in Physics
activities.learning_activity: (c) Use various methods to disseminate scientific results in Physics (reports, journal articles and case studies)
suggested_methods: Problem-based learning: Provide students with real-world problems or challenges related to scientific investigations and allow them to prepare reports and disseminate them
activities.assessment_criteria: Various methods are used to disseminate scientific results

activities.main_competence: 3.0 Conduct a project in Physics
activities.specific_competence: 3.1 Conduct a project in Physics
activities.learning_activity: (a) Design and carry out a research project in Physics
suggested_methods: Problem solving: Guide students in groups to think critically on the best methods they can apply in solving scientific challenges faced in their environment
Project work: Guide students on project development process then task them to develop a research project related to Physics
activities.assessment_criteria: Research project has been designed and carried out by considering scientific procedures

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of concepts, theories and principles in Physics
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of the concepts, theories and principles in Physics
activities.learning_activity: (a) Explain the principles, theories and concepts of current electricity (direct and alternating current and electrical networks)
suggested_methods: Brainstorming: Guide students in groups to brainstorm on the applications of current electricity in their environment
Multimedia approach: Guide students to utilise interactive digital sources to explore the hands-on activities to explain the principles, theories and concepts of current electricity
Practical work: Guide students to explore on principles, theories and concepts of current electricity through hands-on activities
activities.assessment_criteria: Principles, theories and concepts of current electricity are clearly explained

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of concepts, theories and principles in Physics
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of the concepts, theories and principles in Physics
activities.learning_activity: (b) Explore the basic tenets of electromagnetism (electromagnetic force, induction and electromagnetic waves)
suggested_methods: Group discussion: Facilitate group discussions for students to share their experiences on the basic tenets of electromagnetism and ask them some questions related to those concepts
Multimedia approach: Use interactive computer simulations and animations to provide a virtual environment for students to explore and manipulate variables related to electromagnetism
Hands-on experiments: Conduct hands-on experiments that demonstrate the principles of electromagnetism
activities.assessment_criteria: Principles underlying the phenomenon of electromagnetism are correctly explored

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of concepts, theories and principles in Physics
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of the concepts, theories and principles in Physics
activities.learning_activity: (c) Explore the basic tenets of electronics and telecommunication (band theory, semiconductors, transistors, logic gates and satellites)
suggested_methods: Flipped classroom: Assign students some activities to visit nearby small workshops for learning about different electronic components and devices in which they are used
Cooperative learning: Guide the students to share their experiences and understanding on the basic tenets of electronics and telecommunication
Project work: Facilitate students to do projects using concepts, theories, principles and laws in the field of electronics and telecommunication to develop prototype devices

Multimedia approach: Guide students by utilizing interactive digital sources to explore the hands-on activities which will enable the students to describe the concepts and principles related to electronics and telecommunication
activities.assessment_criteria: Concepts and principles related to electronics and telecommunication are correctly described

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of concepts, theories and principles in Physics
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of the concepts, theories and principles in Physics
activities.learning_activity: (d) Explore some advanced tenets of atomic Physics (atomic transitions, nuclear physics, LASER, X-rays, α, β and γ radiations)
suggested_methods: Multimedia approach: Guide students by utilising interactive digital sources to explore the hands-on activities related to the advanced tenets of atomic physics
Field trip: Organise a field trip to a nearby institution dealing with the applications of atomic physics for students to learn
activities.assessment_criteria: Concepts and principles related to atomic physics are correctly described

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of concepts, theories and principles in Physics
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of the concepts, theories and principles in Physics
activities.learning_activity: (e) Explore the basic tenets of energy and energy sources (solar radiation, wind energy, hydropower and thermal reactors)
suggested_methods: Inquiry-based learning: Ask students to explore the basic tenets of energy and their sources through guiding questions and resources

Field trips and guest speakers: Organize field trips to a nearby energy facilities or invite guest speakers to share their experiences with students about energy sources and guide the students to write a report
activities.assessment_criteria: Principles and concepts of energy sources are correctly explored
suggested_resources: Diagram of hydro- electric power plant

activities.main_competence: 1.0 Demonstrate mastery of concepts, theories and principles in Physics
activities.specific_competence: 1.1 Demonstrate an advanced understanding of the concepts, theories and principles in Physics
activities.learning_activity: (f) Explore the basic tenets of medical Physics (nervous system, electrocardiography, diagnostic imaging and radiotherapy)
